name: Onix Accra 1 / Onix Data Centre, Amrahia
notes: Graphic Online reported inauguration of a 20MW colocation data centre at Amrahia in Adentan Municipality; Onix official site describes its flagship Tier IV carrier-neutral colocation facility in Accra.

name: Africa Data Centres Accra ACC1 / Ghana Trade Fair Redevelopment Project
notes: DCD reported ADC acquired land and was set to begin construction in Accra; first phase at La in the Ghana Trade Fair Redevelopment Project designed for 10MW, expandable to 30MW.

name: Agility Logistics Park Tema data center campus
notes: Agility official campus page lists Tema Free Trade Zone site with 30MW committed from day 1 and scale to 150MW; DCD also notes Agility's announced Tema-area plans.

name: PAIX Accra / RackAfrica ACC-1
notes: DCD reported PAIX expanded its Accra facility, locally known as RackAfrica, to 1.2MW of IT capacity; tenants include Ecoband Networks and Teledata ICT.

name: Digital Realty Accra ACR2
notes: Digital Realty announced its first Ghana data center, ACR2, in Accra; Digital Realty's Accra page lists ACR2 at Bank Street and Prof. Atta Mills High Street with 1,100 sq m / 11,800 sq ft colocation space.

name: Equinix Accra AC1
notes: Equinix official Ghana colocation page says it operates one data center just outside Accra, providing about 5,640 sq ft / 524 sq m of colocation space.

name: National Data Centre / Primary Ghana National Data Center Accra
notes: DCD reported Ghana opened a $300m three-hall NITA data center in Accra with 600 server racks; Ghana NCA later described a Tier-3 National Data Centre with 600-rack capacity.

name: Bank of Ghana Ahinsan Data Centre and Disaster Recovery Site
notes: DCD reported Ghana's central bank launched a backup data center in Kumasi, Ashanti Region; facility at Ahinsan spans three stories and about 2,890 sq m total floor space.

name: Ghana Link Kumasi Tier IV Data Centre for ICUMS
notes: Citi Newsroom reported Ghana Link's new Kumasi Tier IV Data Centre supporting the Integrated Customs Management System had achieved ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification.

name: Ghana Immigration Service Kintampo IT Data Centre
developer: Ghana Immigration Service / Kintampo Municipal Assembly
notes: Modern Ghana reported the Bono East Regional Command of the Ghana Immigration Service at Kintampo received a state-of-the-art IT data centre furnished with ICT equipment for service operations.
